slot.brief: Fraction/mass remaining after n half-lives; count half-lives from given total time

stem: A radioactive nuclide has a half-life of $5$ h. What fraction of its initial nuclei remains undecayed after $15$ h?

verdicts.working: 15 h is 3 half-lives, so the remaining fraction is $(1/2)^3=1/8$.

working:
$n = \dfrac{15\ \text{h}}{5\ \text{h}} = 3$
$\dfrac{N}{N_0} = \left(\dfrac{1}{2}\right)^n = \dfrac{1}{8}$

Independent check: 15 h is 3 half-lives, so the remaining fraction is $(1/2)^3=1/8$.
